assets.caption: Fig. 1400-20 Performance of LEV Packings in Block Valves at the Richmond Refinery
assets.notes: Dual-axis bar chart showing average emission rate (kg/hr, log scale, left axis) and percent emission control (right axis) for four packing types: Garlock #70 (99.86%), Slade 3300G (99.57%), Garlock EVSP (98.35%), and Graphaseal (76.99%). Legend shows Before LEV Installation (light bars), After LEV Installation (dark bars), and % Emission Control (line). January 1998 label on left margin.
